instruction.en:
Legacy LivingColors Iris (LLC010) with a Gen 2 or Gen 3 LivingColors remote: hold the remote close to the lamp and press ON + Favorite 1 until the lamp blinks and turns orange; a successful pairing ends with green. Gen 1 LivingColors remotes/devices do not support Zigbee pairing.

For newer Hue Iris models, reset the lamp with a Hue-compatible reset method first, then start pairing.
